conclusion: The campaign's own standard detector reports `confirmatory` absent in all 128 rounds: every finding was discovered and tested on the same 968 prompts. This round splits them by a sha256 of the prompt id under a salt fixed in source before any number was computed -- 466 discovery, 502 confirmation -- and recomputes every settled headline on both. Of 7 headlines, 5 CONFIRMED (same sign, confirmation CI contains the discovery point), 1 ATTENUATED (same sign, discovery overstated the size), 1 FAILED. polarity_ratio_beta_neg_over_beta_pos: CONFIRMED; acc_core: ATTENUATED; acc_full_equal: CONFIRMED; acc_full_signed: CONFIRMED; contested_log_odds_of_verbatim_retention: CONFIRMED; veto_core_minus_human_peer: FAILED; own_minus_stranger_weights: CONFIRMED. WHAT THIS DOES NOT BUY: both halves come from one release, one annotator panel and one judge, so a surviving finding has been shown not to be an artifact of WHICH PROMPTS were read, and nothing more.
